reviews.title: Liquid tracking
reviews.text:
I am new to PlateAI so I cannot comment too deeply. But, I lost 18kgs in five months using the app Simple, but last week it stopped reading, analyzing and making recommendations for restaurant menus. I travel five days per week and menu analysis is essential for me. With the help of AI, I just did extensive research of available apps, and PlateAI came out on top. (Side Note: ChatGPT did not find it, but Claude did. When I asked ChatGPT about PlateAI, it also became the top recommendation).

PlateAI seems to do it all:
-restaurant menu analysis and recommendations
(Including reading a photo of a hand-written menu in Italian on a chalkboard).  
-food plate analysis
-daily and ongoing nutritional tracking
-AI coach and advice 
-there seem to be a lot of cooking and recipe features too, but I don’t cook. 

However, there is one thing that I find strange, PlateAI tracks all drinks other than water as food. I want to drink 2 liters of liquids per day, not just track pure water. I don’t like that PlateAI tracks other beverages as food and doesn’t include them in the daily liquid intake. I have to track liquid intake manually. I hope that is improved in a future feature update!  

4 stars for now, I will update to 5 stars if they improve the beverage/liquid features, and after I use it more extensively.

I'm impressed with this app and I've got more than 40 years in IT and cyber security supporting developers.

reviews.title: Calorie Tracker
reviews.text: If you believe in the calories in-calories out theory of weight management this app is for you. Its philosophy seems to be that if only you had better guidance and coaching around how many calories you’re consuming you would lose weight (the blame the victim model). As a nutritionist, I don’t use that model because it has been proven to fail again and again for sustainable weight loss. I would never recommend this app.

Apparently I had a trial before although I don’t remember this and find no evidence in my records. The company never responded to my inquiry. And when this trial was done I was charged without any notification that the trial was coming to an end. When I contacted the company they told me to take it up with Apple. Ok

reviews.title: One stop shop
reviews.text: This is an amazing app and is the only one that I have ever found to be easy to stick to. I love the nutrient/vitamin tracking, how I can put my shopping list in it (even non food items). It has widgets so I don’t have to go in the app to know where I stand for the day. It really does make tracking so incredibly easy. Personally, I feel like it subtly encourages me to make good choices without it telling me what to do. Totally worth the subscription. Highly recommend!

reviews.title: Best calorie counting app
reviews.text: Takes in account all choices and lifestyles before determining the best course of action for your health!! Love this part. Very easy and quick to log your foods in, allowing you to pick custom or already existing food/recipes. The AI coach has recommended questions if you’re not sure where to start asking and gives in depth responses. If you’re looking for everything a wellness-diet-calorie-tracking app could have, it’s all right here for you to use!! Highly recommend

reviews.title: Next level awesomeness
reviews.text: I have used MyNetDiary for years, and PlateAI takes it to the next level. Food entry is super straightforward now, and I loved the restaurant menu scan and AI generated hints for what to choose. The coach is also very helpful. PlateAI takes the great parts of MyNetDiary (food database, diet preferences, premium meals) and adds a level of ease and conversation to it to make a truly awesome app.

reviews.title: Incredible AI App! Worth the price
reviews.text: I’ve been an avid user of MyNetDiary for years now. I was very excited to hear about this app and see how they integrated a personalized AI coach based off my logging history. This is definitely the next best thing, I highly recommend!
